claims.statement: Tom Allen and Mike McCoole agreed to a prize fight on September 23, 1873.
claims.excerpt: take place on the 23d of September

claims.statement: Tom Allen handed four $100 bills to stakeholder Jno. R. Scott at Tom Kelly's saloon as the second deposit of $400 a side for the Allen and McCoole fight; McCoole's representative William Brown handed over a similar amount.
claims.excerpt: Crowds of the fancy were in attendance and thronged the
places: Tom Kelly's saloon, Sixth street near Market

claims.statement: Three more $500 deposits were due in July, August and September 1873 for the Allen and McCoole fight.
claims.excerpt: Three more deposits will be made. of $500 each,

claims.statement: On June 10, 1873, Tom Allen weighed about 200 pounds and was in good health.
claims.excerpt: At present he weighs about 200 pounds, and is in goo! health.

claims.statement: Tom Allen stayed at home taking longer walks to reduce to 170 pounds fighting weight, and would not go into training quarters for nearly two months.
claims.excerpt: He will not go into traming quarters for nearly two months

fights.stakes: $400 a side second deposit; three more $500 deposits due
fights.excerpt: take place on the 23d of September
fights.notes: Scheduled, not yet fought. The place is not given. Articles of agreement were set for that evening.

notes: Fight is planned, not yet fought, so result is unknown. Deposit amounts read from OCR ('#400 aside'). Hint 3 says 'health' and 'training at home'; the claim is kept with the excerpt as printed.
